segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: Ah, Caroline ... come on in. Sit down.

segments.speaker: CAROLINE
segments.en: Thanks.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: So how’s the dissertation planning going?

segments.speaker: CAROLINE
segments.en: Well Dr. Schulmann, I’m still having a lot of trouble deciding on a title.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: Well, that’s perfectly normal at this stage. And this is what your tutorials will help you to do.

segments.speaker: CAROLINE
segments.en: Right.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: What we’ll do is jot down some points that might help you in your decision. First of all, you have chosen your general topic area, haven’t you?

segments.speaker: CAROLINE
segments.en: Yes, it’s the fishing industry [[ ]] .

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: Oh yes, that was one of the areas you mentioned. Now, what aspects of the course are you good at?

segments.speaker: CAROLINE
segments.en: Well, I think I’m coping well with statistics [[ ]] , and I’m never bored by it.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: Good. Anything else?

segments.speaker: CAROLINE
segments.en: Well, I found computer modelling fascinating – I have no problem following what’s being taught, whereas quite a few of my classmates find it difficult.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: Well, that’s very good. Do you think these might be areas you could bring into your dissertation?

segments.speaker: CAROLINE
segments.en: Oh yes, if possible. It’s just that I’m having difficulty thinking how I can do that. You see I feel I don’t have sufficient background information.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: I see. Well, do you take notes?

segments.speaker: CAROLINE
segments.en: I’m very weak at note-taking [[ ]] . My teachers always used to say that.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: Well, I think you really need to work on these weaknesses before you go any further.

segments.speaker: CAROLINE
segments.en: What do you suggest?

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: Well, I can go through the possible strategies with you and let you decide where to go from there.

segments.speaker: CAROLINE
segments.en: Okay, thanks.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: Well, some people find it helpful to organise peer-group discussions – you know, each week a different person studies a different topic and shares it with the group.

segments.speaker: CAROLINE
segments.en: Oh right.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: It really helps build confidence [[ ]] , you know, having to present something to others.

segments.speaker: CAROLINE
segments.en: I can see that.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: The drawback is that everyone in the group seems to share the same ideas [[ ]] ... they keep being repeated in all the dissertations.

segments.speaker: CAROLINE
segments.en: Okay.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: You could also try a service called ‘Student Support‘ [[ ]] . It’s designed to give you a structured programme over a number of weeks to develop your skills.

segments.speaker: CAROLINE
segments.en: Sounds good.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: Yes, unfortunately, there are only a few places [[ ]] . But it’s worth looking into.

segments.speaker: CAROLINE
segments.en: Yes, of course. I know I’ve got to work on my study skills.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: And then there are several study skills books you can consult.

segments.speaker: CAROLINE
segments.en: Right.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: They’ll be a good source of reference but the problem is they are sometimes too general [[ ]] .

segments.speaker: CAROLINE
segments.en: Yes, that’s what I’ve found.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: Other than that I would strongly advise quite simple ideas like using a card index.

segments.speaker: CAROLINE
segments.en: Well, yes, I’ve never done that before.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: It’s simple, but it really works because you have to get points down in a small space. Another thing I always advise is don’t just take your notes and forget about them. Read everything three times [[ ]] – that’ll really fix them in your mind.

segments.speaker: CAROLINE
segments.en: Yes, I can see it’d take discipline but ...

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: Well, if you establish good study skills at this stage they’ll be with you all your life.

segments.speaker: CAROLINE
segments.en: Oh yes, I completely agree. It’s just that I don’t seem to be able to discipline myself. I need to talk things over.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: Well, we’ll be continuing these tutorials of course. Let’s arrange next month’s now. Let’s see, I can see you virtually any time during the week starting 22nd January.

segments.speaker: CAROLINE
segments.en: What about the 24th? I’m free in the afternoon.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: Sorry, I’m booked then. What about the following day?

segments.speaker: CAROLINE
segments.en: Thursday? I can make the morning.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: Fine, we’ll go for the 25th then [[ ]] .

segments.speaker: CAROLINE
segments.en: That’s great, thanks.
